CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.
   B. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.
   D. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.
   B. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   C. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Development of Christianity in East Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Growth of the Church in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Comparative Religion Selected World Religions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Church Doctrine Sin and Salvation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Development of Christianity in East Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Comparative Religion Selected World Religions; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Church Doctrine Sin and Salvation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
